item.title: Don't Let the AI Write Your Code: A Haskell Developer's Anti-Burnout Playbook
item.description: A 10,000-word, 100% human-written post on the Haskell Discourse blew up on HN (163 points, 216 comments). A professional Haskell developer draws a precise line through LLM-assisted development: the machine plans, researches, and reviews — you write the code. Here's the reasoning.

item.title: Claude Code Rate Limiting Truth: $200 Unlimited Plan Becomes Limited Supply
item.description: Anthropic implements rate limiting on Claude Code, affecting $200 unlimited plan users. Deep analysis of AI service throttling reasons, developer impact, and industry trends, revealing the truth behind AI 'unlimited usage' claims.
